info.title: TenkaCloud Simulator API
info.description: Independent local cloud simulator. AWS S3 is the first provider. No real infrastructure is created. This document describes only implemented operations. S3 wire APIs retain their XML formats; simulator IAM control is explicitly a separate JSON API. Use unsigned requests or dummy TCSIM SDK credentials. Default principal simulator-admin has full sandbox access. For IAM exercises send x-simulator-principal. SQLite is ephemeral by default; --state persists it. See /_simulator/v1/capabilities for limits and deviations.

post.summary: SSM JSON or CloudFormation Query operation
post.description: Native regional root endpoint. SSM: X-Amz-Target AmazonSSM.PutParameter, GetParameter, GetParameters, GetParametersByPath, DescribeParameters, DeleteParameter. CloudFormation: CreateStack, DescribeStacks, DeleteStack; only SSM parameters and one inline IAM identity policy per role. Unsupported options fail. Real credentials and session tokens are rejected.

get.summary: List objects or get bucket location
get.description: ListObjectsV2: keep list-type=2; supports prefix, delimiter, max-keys and continuation. GetBucketLocation: omit list-type and send an empty location query. S3 uses one path for these two wire operations; this reference does not invent a REST adapter.
